snippets.TEXT_WELCOME: Penelope Panda invites you to her favourite beauty salon! Get yourself a manicure, a new hair-do or design your own clothes!
snippets.TEXT_WELCOME1: Style your nails with a wide range of colors and shapes. Your hands are even more beautiful with a ring or a sticker!
snippets.TEXT_WELCOME2: It has never been so easy to change your appearance! Choose your favorite new haircut, change your hair colour and get some streaks in your hair! Don't forget your make-up and the jewellery!
snippets.TEXT_WELCOME3: Be a designer! First choose your favorite clothes and shoes. Then choose the colour that best fits your design and unique creations!
